title: Krawtchouk value as a polynomial coefficient
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$, and let $j$ be a natural number. The sum of the degree-$j$ monomials in the coordinates of $x$ equals the coefficient of $X^j$ in $(1-X)^{m}(1+X)^{n-m}$, where $m$ is the number of negative coordinates of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is an element of the $n$-dimensional sign cube
